corrections.what: Record said the acquittal was reversed 'for him'. No source gives Daviély's gender (ex-gerente and gerente do not mark it). All three records reworded without a pronoun.

2024 record tied Ponte Nova and a count of 21 to A Gazeta. A Gazeta does not mention Ponte Nova; Diário do Grande ABC and Brasil de Fato do. Count of 21 now credited to A Gazeta, with DGABC's five named people beside it. Source link changed to DGABC.
Post dates were 'not given'. DGABC gives Germano and Wagner 2014-2015 as gerente-geral, Daviély 2008-2015. Added with credit.

2026 record said reversal without saying partial. Now says acquittals of others were upheld (MPF; A Gazeta). Added spelling note Daviély/Daviely/Daviéli and a line that pages do not set out personal acts, to the summary.
Summary gave 14 days flat; sources split 14/15. Summary now says so.

File said VOA calls 'another person', Tran Nguyen Thanh, chairman. Very likely the same man: Trần Nguyên Thành is the Vietnamese reading of 陳源成 and Báo Pháp Luật uses it for the chairman who wrote the same staff letter. Reworded, saying no page states it outright. The link between readings is my inference.

Apology quote ended in a false full stop mid-sentence. Full sentence restored, marked as Viet Nam News's English; added AP and Government Portal wordings and the note that the statement was translated (TechNews).
Post 'from 1 August 2014' overstated Kallanish, which says he joined Formosa then. Reworded.

Anchor 106.4081, 18.1119 is about 8 km north of the plant at Wikipedia's 18.04, 106.43. Moved to Wikipedia's point, labelled approximate. The case formosa-ha-tinh-marine-disaster still uses the old point; not changed here.

Summary said 'shooting took place on his directions' beside 13 killed, which implied he directed the fatal firing. Now gives the two specific shootings and says pages do not say whether anyone died in them.
'22 May 2018' changed to 22-23 May (The News Minute). 14-versus-13 death count disclosed.

'Affidavit of 31 August 2026': DT Next gives the Monday hearing, not the affidavit's own date. Reworded to 'put before the court at the hearing on 31 August 2026'; the second DT Next story confirms 31 August as the hearing date.
2023 record credited 'under examination' to the November article, which does not use the phrase; it is in the 30 December 2023 News Minute story. Record rewritten; FIR letter added.

Added record: state refused to reconsider the previous DMK government's decision (DT Next, 11 Sept 2026). Added the state's counter-affidavit position (The Hindu via inkl), further CBI investigation. 'Made no ruling on him' changed to 'report records no finding'. 'Certainly exceeded the limit' credited to Frontline via The South First, and it applied to a group.
Anchor coordinates kept, label and placed_basis corrected: the point is the District Collectorate, and 'the shooting site' overstated it.
